markdown_content: # Group Internal Lines in CLO 2025.0 This document explains the new feature in CLO 2025.0 that allows users to group internal lines and shapes using the Transform Pattern Tool and Edit Pattern Tool. It covers procedures for grouping, ungrouping, moving, scaling, and editing grouped elements while highlighting tool-specific behaviors. ## Grouping Internal Lines and Shapes with Transform Pattern Tool CLO 2025.0 introduces the ability to group internal lines or shapes, enhancing pattern editing workflows. Using the **Transform Pattern Tool**, users can select multiple internal lines or shapes—such as those traced from graphics—and group them into a single entity. ### Procedure 1. Select all desired internal lines or shapes using the **Transform Pattern Tool**. 2. Right-click on the selection and choose **Group**. 3. Once grouped, moving or scaling the group affects all elements simultaneously. 4. Using the **Edit Pattern Tool** on a grouped set allows individual adjustments of each internal line or shape. 5. Users can selectively group or ungroup subsets by selecting elements, right-clicking, and choosing **Group** or **Ungroup**. 6. The **Transform Pattern Tool** honors groupings, meaning it treats grouped elements as one entity for transformations like move or scale. ### Key Points - Grouping is primarily recognized and respected by the **Transform Pattern Tool**. - The **Edit Pattern Tool** allows detailed edits of individual elements within a group. - Grouped elements move and scale collectively when manipulated with the **Transform Pattern Tool**. - Ungrouping and regrouping can be done flexibly depending on editing needs. ## Grouping Internal Lines Specifically with Edit Pattern Tool While the **Transform Pattern Tool** handles grouping broadly, grouping internal lines specifically using the **Edit Pattern Tool** requires a slightly different approach. ### Procedure 1. Switch to the **Edit Pattern Tool**. 2. Select internal lines individually by holding **Shift** and clicking each line. 3. Right-click on the selected lines and choose **Group**. 4. Once grouped, these internal lines can be moved or resized collectively. 5. The **Edit Pattern Tool** allows grouping and ungrouping but edits elements individually. 6. The **Transform Pattern Tool** will respect these groupings when applied. ### Limitations - The **Group** option does not appear when right-clicking without selecting multiple internal lines. - Grouping internal lines is more manual, requiring individual selection. - Editing grouped internal lines is granular within the **Edit Pattern Tool**, but grouping helps with bulk transformations via the **Transform Pattern Tool**. --- This grouping functionality streamlines pattern modification by allowing multiple internal lines or shapes to be manipulated as one entity, while still permitting detailed individual edits as needed. It leverages the synergy between CLO's **Transform Pattern Tool** and **Edit Pattern Tool** to provide flexible pattern editing workflows in the 2025.0 release.
